description: This file contains tests for the provider authentication choices manifest helpers for a plugin system. It uses Vitest testing framework, mocks manifest registry loading, and verifies behavior of functions that resolve and flatten provider auth choices, handle deprecated aliases, and filter trusted/untrusted plugins.

methods.description: Creates a provider authentication choice record with optional overrides.
